_meta.description: Sashi MCP tool manifest — real tool definitions, not stubs

tools.name: sashi_ask
tools.description: Query the local LLM (llama3.2 via ollama). Local-first, offline-capable. Returns plain-text response.

prompt.description: The question or task to send to the local model

model.description: Override the model. Defaults to LOCAL_MODEL env var (llama3.2).

tools.name: sashi_code
tools.description: Code generation via local LLM. Prepends a coding-assistant system context. Optimised for concise, runnable output.

tools.name: sashi_file_read
tools.description: Read a file from the local filesystem. Size-aware (streams large files), binary-safe (refuses binary unless mode=binary), encoding-aware.

path.description: Absolute or relative path to the file

head_n.description: If > 0, return only the first N lines

tools.name: sashi_file_write
tools.description: Atomically write content to a file (tmp→mv pattern). Optional backup of existing file before overwrite.

backup.description: Create a timestamped .bak before overwriting. Default: false

tools.name: sashi_file_append
tools.description: Append content to a file with flock-based concurrency safety. Enforces a max size limit before rejecting.

max_mb.description: Reject append if file exceeds this size (MB). Default: 100

tools.name: sashi_llm_write
tools.description: Run the local LLM against a prompt and write the output atomically to a file. The core agentic write primitive.

outfile.description: Destination file path for LLM output

prompt.description: Prompt to send to the local model

tools.name: sashi_llm_process
tools.description: Read an input file, pass its content + a prompt to the local LLM, write output to a new file. The read→infer→write pipeline.

prompt.description: Task instruction applied to the file content

tools.name: sashi_history
tools.description: Return the last N query records from the shared SQLite history database.

limit.description: Number of records to return. Default: 20

tools.name: sashi_status
tools.description: Return system status: ollama health, model list, gRPC server states, query statistics.

tools.name: sashi_kanban
tools.description: Query the kanban board. Returns column counts (board) or card lists per column.

view.description: Which view to return. Default: board
